task.title: Installing StreamForge Capture
task.shortdesc: Download and install StreamForge Capture on Windows or macOS.

context.p: StreamForge Capture has a single installer per platform and no auto-configuration wizard—it opens directly into a ready-to-use default scene.

step.cmd: Download the installer for your platform from the StreamForge site.
Run the installer and accept the default install location.

taskbody.result: StreamForge Capture opens with one default scene containing a webcam and microphone source, ready to record.
